verdict.rationale: Reflect's AI is built in, with a toggle between GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet, but it offers no AI-specific connectors or AI plugin ecosystem. Community users note Reflect is designed to work without plugins. External AI tools could only reach notes through a limited OAuth2/PKCE API (appending data, listing bookmarks), Zapier, or deep links. Missing for 10: first-party connectors for external LLMs/AI tools (e.g. an MCP server), an AI plugin ecosystem, an API with full note read access for AI tools, and published API specs or llms.txt (both probed as 404).
